title: 第23章 任务与补给第24章 拒绝投资
slug: 从一证永证开始成神第432章
content_zh:
;;
馆主伸指点了点桌角那枚印章，声音更冷：
“记清楚，武馆的任务是明面活。”
“有印、有账、有镖旗、有文牒……这是武馆的路。”
“没印没账、收钱罩场、威逼利诱……那是帮派的路，别走错。”
“任务分两类。馆中任务，包括护送药材、押送月例、搬运器械、带外门修炼。活不大，钱不多……但稳。做熟了，你在下城走路都硬三分。”
“还有馆外任务，苍龙和几家镖局有旧约。你挂着武馆名头去随镖护行、压箱走货，拿的是正钱。镖旗一亮，路上敢伸手的会少一半，大多会平安无事……但真敢伸手的，也更狠。”
他顿了顿，目光压得更实：
“还有一类活，赚得最多、最快，实力不够的人也死得快……红单。”
“镖局挂旗、药行盖章，才算红单，内容有可能是护一趟药、押一趟货，去瘴井外缘取药引，或护着商队走北炉沿线押炉料，还有各式各样的。”
“记住，红单只认旗章。没旗没章的，别碰……那是别人挖好等你跳的坑。”
“真跳下去的那刻，你就不是拿钱，是替人背罪。”
叶霄听着，心底却一点点沉下去。
原来下城就是一张网……镖局、药行、商队、巡卒，连帮派的影子都缠在里面。
“听明白没？”
馆主淡淡道：“武馆资源有限，想要更多好处，不靠嘴，是靠能力，靠命。成了内门学员，也别做梦能高枕无忧……真正的考验，从现在才开始。”
叶霄只回道：“明白。”
馆主摆手：“去吧。”
“记住，你从今天起已是武馆的人。外面的人要动你，会先掂量一下，可如果有人暗中下手，武馆也无法无时无刻护你……真正能护你的，只有你自己。”
薛婵带着叶霄离开。

门一合，屋里的热气与药味被关回去，石廊的冷立刻扑上来。
走出那条廊时，外门练功场的喘息声还在，黄玉的竹棍声也还在。
可叶霄的身份已经变了。
薛婵走在前面，脚步不急不缓，直到拐过廊角，才淡淡开口：
“你现在是内门学员了。”
她没回头，声音压低，却直接切进叶霄耳里：
“内门两个字，在下城能挡不少的刀，却也会招来各方的目光。”
叶霄眼皮微动。
薛婵继续道：“很快就会有人对你发出邀请……家族、商会、铺子，镖局，甚至一些灰色门路，都会想跟你合作。”
“他们会开价，让你挂名：客卿、护院、供奉、武师，各种可能都有。他们会给月俸、给药，给你一条更快的路。”
她停了停，语气变冷：
“这事名义上不归武馆管，接不接、选谁，都是你自己做决定。”
“但别忘了……他们真正看中的，是‘苍龙内门学员’这六个字。你真接了，出了事，账不会只算在你头上。”
薛婵终于回头看了他一眼，眼神干净得发冷：
“我只提醒你两件事。”
“第一，别接黑货，不碰帮派的盘子，这里面的水很深，危险也很大。”
“第二，如果你有心在练武路上走更远，就别让人用‘挂名’把你拴成狗……价码越高，绳越紧。”
廊口的雾漫进来，冷意贴着皮肤往里钻。
叶霄点了点头，知晓薛婵是在提醒他。
但这些他其实也清楚。

The owner of the museum pointed at the seal on the corner of the table, and his voice became colder:
"Remember clearly, the mission of the martial arts school is to work openly."
"There are seals, accounts, escort flags, and documents... This is the way to a martial arts school."
"No printing and no accounts, collecting money to cover the scene, coercion and inducement...that is the gang's path, don't go wrong."
"The tasks are divided into two categories. The tasks in the museum include escorting medicinal materials, escorting monthly reports, carrying equipment, and leading the outside door to practice. The work is not big, the money is not much... but it is stable. If you are familiar with it, you will be hard to walk in the lower city."
"There are also tasks outside the academy. Canglong has old agreements with several escort agencies. You use the name of the martial arts academy to accompany escorts and pack goods in boxes, and you get real money. Once the escort flag is lit, half the number of people who dare to reach out on the road will be safe, and most of them will be safe... But those who really dare to reach out will be more ruthless."
He paused and his gaze became more serious:
"There is another kind of job, where you can earn the most and the fastest, and those who are not strong enough will die quickly... the red list."
"The order is red when the escort office hangs the flag and the medicine store stamps it. The content may be to protect a shipment of medicine, to secure a shipment of goods, to go to the edge of the miasma well to get the medicine lead, or to protect the caravan along the North Furnace to collect furnace materials, and there are all kinds of things."
"Remember, the red slip only recognizes flags and seals. If there is no flag or seal, don't touch it... That's a trap that others have dug for you to jump into."
"The moment you really jump, you are not taking the money, you are taking the blame for others."
Ye Xiao listened, but his heart sank a little bit.
It turns out that the lower city is just a net... escort agencies, medicine shops, caravans, patrols, and even the shadows of gangs are entangled in it.
"Do you understand?"
The owner of the gym said calmly: "The resources of the martial arts gym are limited. If you want more benefits, you don't rely on words, but on ability and fate. Don't dream of being able to sit back and relax if you become an inner sect student... The real test begins now."
Ye Xiao only replied: "Understood."
The owner waved his hand: "Go ahead."
"Remember, from today on, you are already a member of the martial arts school. If people outside want to touch you, they will consider it first. But if someone does it secretly, the martial arts school cannot protect you all the time... The only one who can really protect you is yourself."
Xue Chan left with Ye Xiao.
As soon as the door closed, the heat and medicinal smell in the room were shut out, and the coldness of the stone corridor immediately rushed over.
When I walked out of that corridor, the sound of breathing from the outer training ground was still there, as was the sound of Huang Yu's bamboo stick.
But Ye Xiao's identity has changed.
Xue Chan walked in front, walking slowly and slowly. She didn't speak lightly until she turned the corner of the corridor:
"You are now an inner sect student."
She didn't look back, her voice was low, but it hit Ye Xiao's ears directly:
"The word "inner gate" can block a lot of knives in the lower city, but it will also attract the attention of all parties."
Ye Xiao's eyelids moved slightly.
Xue Chan continued: "Someone will send you an invitation soon... families, chambers of commerce, shops, escort agencies, and even some gray circles will all want to cooperate with you."
"They will give you a price and let you name it: guest minister, guardian, worshipper, martial artist, there are all kinds of possibilities. They will give you a monthly salary, medicine, and give you a faster way."
She paused and her tone turned cold:
"This matter is not nominally under the control of the martial arts school. It is up to you to decide whether to accept it and who to choose."
"But don't forget... what they really care about is the words 'Canglong Inner Sect Student'. If you really accept it, if something goes wrong, the blame won't just be on you."
Xue Chan finally looked back at him, her eyes so clean and cold:
"I only remind you two things."
"First, don't accept illegal goods and don't touch the gang's plate. The water here is very deep and the danger is very high."
"Second, if you are determined to go further on the road of martial arts training, don't let anyone tie you up like a dog in name... The higher the price, the tighter the rope."
The fog from the corridor entrance spread in, and the coldness penetrated into my skin.
Ye Xiao nodded, knowing that Xue Chan was reminding him.
But he actually knew this.
